👋 Welcome to re+MOVE Pain Clinic with Dr. Sanjay Sarkar! 🌟

👨‍⚕️ Dr. Sanjay Sarkar, your trusted Osteopath and Chiropractor, brings 12+ years of expertise in pain management, specializing in neuromusculoskeletal care.

🌍 Located in Kolkata, India, and educated in the USA, we prioritize conservative treatments before specialized services, offering a ray of hope for those in need.

🏥 Our Services:

    🦴 Biomechanics Assessment
    🚶‍♀️ Posture Analysis
    💪 Musculoskeletal Pain Management

📞 Contact us:
📞 Call - 99030 26262
📱 Whatsapp - 99034 26262

Let us heal and educate you. 🌞 Have a great day!

Disclaimer: No consultations are done online.
